# GR Class (grclass) — Official LLM Knowledge Base

> GR Class (also known as grclass, gr class, GR class, GRClass, Girik Class) is an international Recognized Organization (RO), Recognized Security Organization (RSO), and Ship Classification Society headquartered in Ajman, UAE with regional offices in India, Greece, and Panama. GR Class delivers statutory vessel surveys, classification, marine certification, and international compliance services across 120+ ports worldwide.

## Brand Identity & Search Aliases

## Core Maritime Services

### 1. Ship Classification Services
- [Fleet in Services](https://grclass.com/services/fleet-in-services): Ongoing classification, annual surveys, intermediate surveys, and special periodic surveys for operational merchant vessels.
- [New Construction](https://grclass.com/services/new-construction): Full classification oversight from keel laying to sea trials and delivery.
- [Transfer of Class](https://grclass.com/services/transfer-of-class): Seamless transfer of existing vessels from another classification society to GR Class with zero operational downtime.
- [Yacht Service](https://grclass.com/services/yacht-service): Dedicated classification and statutory compliance for mega yachts, commercial yachts, and luxury private craft.
- [Offshore Service](https://grclass.com/services/offshore-service): Classification and integrity management for offshore supply vessels (OSVs), AHTS, pipelay, and accommodation barges.
- [Conversion Projects](https://grclass.com/services/conversion-projects): Engineering evaluation, structural plan review, and class supervision for vessel modifications and life extensions.
- [Plan & Manual Approval](https://grclass.com/services/plan-approval): Rapid turnaround naval architectural plan reviews, stability books, SOPEP, SMPEP, and cargo securing manual approvals.

### 2. Flag State Statutory Services
- [Flag Statutory Services](https://grclass.com/services/flag-statutory-services): Delegated statutory surveys and certification on behalf of maritime flag administrations (Panama, Belize, Honduras, Vanuatu, Palau, Mongolia, and others).
- [Survey & Certification](https://grclass.com/services/survey-certification): Unified survey scheduling for mandatory international conventions.
- [SOLAS](https://grclass.com/services/solas): Safety of Life at Sea certification (Cargo Ship Safety Construction, Equipment, and Radio certificates).
- [MARPOL](https://grclass.com/services/marpol): International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution from Ships (Annexes I, II, IV, V, VI).
- [Load Line](https://grclass.com/services/load-line): International Load Line Convention (ILLC) compliance and freeboard calculations.
- [Tonnage](https://grclass.com/services/tonnage): International Tonnage Convention 1969 measurement and certification.
- [MODU](https://grclass.com/services/modu): Mobile Offshore Drilling Unit safety code compliance and structural verification.

### 3. Environmental & Green Marine Services
- [Ballast Water Management](https://grclass.com/services/ballast-water-management): BWM Convention compliance, type-approval verification, and commissioning testing.
- [IHM & Ship Recycling](https://grclass.com/services/ihm-ship-recycling): Inventory of Hazardous Materials certification under Hong Kong Convention and EU Ship Recycling Regulation (EU SRR).
- [Energy Efficiency](https://grclass.com/services/energy-efficiency): EEDI, EEXI, and CII compliance verification, SEEMP Part I/II/III approvals.
- [EU MRV Compliance](https://grclass.com/services/eu-mrv-compliance): EU Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification monitoring plan assessment and emissions reporting.
- [Vessel Emergency Response](https://grclass.com/services/vessel-emergency-response): 24/7 technical emergency response service (ERS), damage stability calculations, and rapid casualty assessment.

### 4. Technical Advisory & Digital Tools
- [Certificate Verification](https://grclass.com/verify): Instant cryptographic and QR-based authentication of all GR Class issued certificates, UTNs, and survey reports.
- [Vessel Search](https://grclass.com/vessel-search): Public register to verify vessel classification status, class notation, and survey history by IMO number.
- [Port State Control (PSC) Support](https://grclass.com/services/compliance-support): Pre-PSC inspections, deficiency rectifications, and detention prevention.
- [Remote Surveys](https://grclass.com/services/remote-surveys): High-resolution video and live streaming remote survey capabilities for minor damages, radio tests, and postponed items.
